texts.text: The Noirs have left behind piles of clothes at the base of this pillar.
Though they must've been luxury items once, they've lost their value after seasons of neglect.
... I don't know if you're curious, or if you just want to kill me, but I don't care. Do what you will.
texts.speaker: เลอ เนอ็องต์

texts.text: This "life" here is just a meaningless simulation that'll fall away once the Grand Magasin crumbles, anyway.
texts.speaker: เลอ เนอ็องต์

texts.text: The strangers have done it. All is as she said.
texts.speaker: เลอ เนอ็องต์
